description: Hand-curated shipped-seed ids for Library kinds WITHOUT a physical oob/user layer (LB0-U3). Ships in the COPY'd tree (api/config/) so it updates with the code on image upgrade. Agents listed here render provenance 'oob' in the Library; any agents/<id>.yaml not listed is operator-created ('user'). tests/test_library_provenance.py asserts every id resolves to a repo agents/<id>.yaml whose 'id' field matches.
